scope: Compiler behaviour on this host's pinned toolchain. A successful check shows the borrow checker did what the note predicts; it says nothing about learner mastery.

cases.teaches: A shared or mutable borrow ends at its last use, not at the end of the block. Two mutable borrows that do not overlap are allowed.
cases.observe: Reusing the same mutable borrow after a read would break this case.

cases.teaches: A returned reference may live as long as the caller-owned input it borrows.
cases.observe: Lifetime annotations describe a relationship; they do not extend storage.

cases.teaches: Two exclusive borrows are rejected when both are still needed at one point.
cases.observe: Writing two unused mutable references is not itself the error; the overlap is.

cases.teaches: Assigning a String moves ownership; the previous binding can no longer be read.
cases.observe: Cloning would compile, but the question is which binding is supposed to own the data.

cases.teaches: A returned reference cannot outlive the local value that owns the storage.
cases.observe: No lifetime annotation can keep a dropped local alive.

cases.teaches: A shared borrow of an element conflicts with an exclusive borrow of the whole vector.
cases.observe: Disjoint-field or split-slice access can resolve this; an unexplained clone only hides it.
